title: Carla’s Famous Smoked Trout Dip
description: If you make it with smoked mackerel and serve it at Christmas, you could call it “Holy Mackerel.”
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice and add more as necessary
Optional - I have also put in some dill pickle chopped finely - maybe 1-2 tablespoons, or some chopped dill weed. I didn't do this at Thanksgiving.
directions: Take skin off trout and break or chop into small pieces.
Add rest of ingredients and mix adjusting as necessary. It should be somewhat chunky.
Chill for a couple of hours, stir and serve with crackers or toasted bread.
